items.title: Evidence of unfair use: AI books squeeze human authors out of the market
items.summary: Anthropic's AI training using millions of used books raised copyright concerns. The market impact of AI-generated content is a key issue.

items.summary: Tradwives, old money, homesteading, even bird watching. Why does Gen Z want to turn the clock back 100 years?

items.title: ‘It will inherit your thoughts’: Musk tells SpaceX employees they’ll be Grok’s ‘parents’ as AI trains on company data
items.summary: In an all-hands, the SpaceX CEO revealed he wants his employees to be the foundation for his AI agent’s knowledge. “It will be trained on you.”

items.title: Social Security is celebrating its 91st birthday. It won’t live to 100, watchdog warns
items.summary: "Social Security won’t make it past age 97 as things currently stand," said the CRFB's Maya Macguineas. "At least not in its current form."
